SolarWinds Orion updates delivered widespread backdoors.

Target: Solarwinds Orion
Repository: N/A
Date: 2019-09-04 to 2020-12-14 (467 days)
Attribution: Nation-state
Component: application
Language: C#
Cause: Build system compromise
Motive: Espionage, Data theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Backdoor, Remote access, Data theft
User Impact: 18000
Domain: solarwinds.com (project download host)
Artifact Type: binary archive
Insertion Phase: CI/CD

Synopsis

Attackers compromised SolarWinds' software build system, inserting a backdoor (Sunburst) into legitimate updates for its Orion IT management platform. This allowed widespread espionage against government and enterprise networks. A secondary backdoor (Supernova) was also deployed.

Compromised Versions

  • Orion Platform 2019.4 HF5 (version 2019.4.5200.9083)
  • Orion Platform 2020.2 RC1 (version 2020.2.100.12219)
  • Orion Platform 2020.2 RC2 (version 2020.2.5200.12394)
  • Orion Platform 2020.2 HF1 (version 2020.2.5300.12432)
